definition.name: CPI-U, all items, U.S. city average
definition.population: All urban consumers; excludes rural nonmetropolitan residents, farm households, military installations, religious communities and institutions as defined by BLS.
definition.cadence: Monthly; normally released the following month at 08:30 America/New_York. Consult the official schedule for changes.
definition.boundary: National urban target in the 50 states and DC, excluding territories. No state, county, metro or DC-only output.
definition.sample_design: 2018 geographic redesign, 2010 Census population / 2013 OMB CBSAs; not an expenditure-weight vintage.
definition.uncertainty_note: Survey-derived index; confidence intervals are not supplied in this extract. Unknown is not zero uncertainty.
definition.revision_policy: NSA CPI-U has no routine seasonal revision; corrections remain possible. Latest publisher values only, not a vintage archive.
definition.licence: US public domain; cite US Bureau of Labor Statistics

footnotes.text: Data unavailable due to the 2025 lapse in appropriations

licence: US public domain; cite US Bureau of Labor Statistics
timing_note: Publication and next-release timestamps are unverified in this reader; consult the linked official schedule. Retrieval time is not publication time. Unchanged monthly observations remain valid.
limitations: Only exact retained calendar months. No annual-average, daily, local, CPI-W, chained/core/SA CPI, arbitrary history or contractual substitutions. Index levels are not USD, percentages or additive totals. Refuse calculations involving a nonnumeric month.
